classification: B: existing MCP registry -> Manifest and frozen native inventory admission. No capability execution, permission, Evidence, auth or System Context boundary moved.
flow: NativeSessionHost -> McpRegistryStore strict bounded source identity -> protocol registry/Manifest adapter -> empty inventory admission -> request authority revalidates inventory source before cognition. Nonempty inventory stays blocked.
facts: Reads the existing mcp-registry.json without creating or rewriting it. Missing source is an empty inventory; corruption/future versions are not treated as empty.
Current v1 and legacy arrays retain transport identity, displayName, visibility, policy metadata, credential-presence flags, stable capability IDs and JavaScript UTF-16 aliases.
Descriptions/schema are untrusted Manifest metadata. Secret headers/env are not exported. required=false remains metadata and never produces a grant.
Strict source reads cap bytes at 1 MiB, nodes at 65536 and depth at 32; server/tool/projected counts are bounded. Symlink, unstable, malformed, future and oversized sources are preserved and blocked.
The real CLI can execute a fresh task with an empty registry. A nonempty or future registry blocks before model dispatch.
An admitted native write that changes the registry stops before the next cognition; its original Result/Evidence and known fee remain, and a later independent task is admitted without replay.
No MCP process, HTTP connection, credential read or tool execution is implemented by this card; stdio, Streamable HTTP and legacy SSE transport gates remain open.
limits: Source implementation and deterministic Host behavior only; no real-model or installed-build acceptance.
The default legacy peer entry has not switched. No app restart/install/release or personal task migration.
Full external transport/auth/PermissionGrant/Evidence, full compaction strategy/Context catalog, remaining providers/network settings and CLI/ACP surfaces are unfinished.
